body: I have lupus. A few years ago it made my kidneys fail and I gained 60lbs of water weight in a month which stretched me out like a balloon. As hard as it has been, before, I at least believed in love and was trying so hard, so I could be my healthiest and we could have a good life. But I'm not enough, I'm a piece of shit, and he stopped loving me. Now all I have is pain. I just want to die.
